description: Every event a Spanish company has published in the BORME (Commercial Registry gazette), with date and PDF: incorporation, director appointments and removals, capital increases, changes of address or name, dissolution, insolvency... Use it for the company history and recent changes; for the current status, get_company is enough. Pro plan. Historial de actos del BORME.
